annotations.title: Report the transaction that landed (Overwing Preflight)

description: After a transaction that Preflight allowed has landed, report its signature. Preflight reads the landed transaction from the chain and says whether the allow held: not_a_miss, or miss when it took more from the wallet than the policy permitted. The outcome is published. A covered miss is paid to the wallet in the verdict, never to whoever reported it. No key needed.

signature.description: The landed transaction's signature in base58
